answer: Time-locked stake bonding mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents tracking wildfire ember alerts, zephyr gusts, or orchard trellis care to lock verifiable collateral in escrow before peers accept their messages, slashing funds upon provable equivocation. Each fake identity therefore incurs a measurable opportunity cost in immobilized capital and forfeiture risk. Still, wealthy attackers can fund many compliant aliases, while steep deposits exclude modest operators.
